name: Stored goods change title or are revalued repeatedly with no physical movement
description: Ownership of goods held in secure storage passes between parties, or declared value changes sharply on entry, exit or transfer, while the items stay in place.
fp: Dealers, collectors and investment funds legitimately trade stored stock without moving it. Concern is a chain of related-party sales or valuations that diverge from the market.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Art and Antiquities Market, 2023
FATF, Money Laundering Vulnerabilities of Free Trade Zones, 2010
OECD, Trade-based money laundering: free trade zones and illicit trade, 2018

links.name: Stored goods change title or are revalued repeatedly with no physical movement
links.ctx: A chain of related-party sales of a painting or bullion in a free port that drives up recorded value without cash movement.
